title: Copper add
description: A mod to add some copper items and armor
body:
This mods add a new armor to minecraft and 2 swords.

**The copper sword :**
when you have totaly the copper armor and if it thunder, it create a lightning on you.
but if you don't have the armor totaly and if it thunder, it give you a darkness effect.

**The copper emerald sword :**
when you have totaly the copper armor and if it thunder, it create a lightning on the mods you had punch.
but if you don't have the armor totaly and if it thunder, it create a lightning on you.
 

When it isn't thunder the swors didn't have any special effect.

The recipes are in the section "Galery" !
